Routine Service: 6-8 weeks (after received by Passport agency) Expedited Service: 2-3 weeks (after received by Passport agency) - extra $60.00 fee applies to expedite MAILING TIMES ARE NOT INCLUDED IN PROCESSING TIMES. Consider the total time it will take to receive your passport when you are booking travel. Urgent applying at Detroit Agency : MUST HAVE INTERNATIONAL TRAVEL WITHIN 14 CALENDAR DAYS. TO MAKE AN APPOINTMENT CALL 1-877-487-2778 from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Mondays through Fridays, or on Saturdays and Sundays from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. This appointment line is closed on federal holidays. HOW MUCH IS A PASSPORT AND/OR PASSPORT CARD? ADULT - 16 YEARS OLD AND OLDER Passport Book - $130.00 Passport Card - $30.00 Passport Book & Card - $160.00 EACH APPLICATION HAS A $35 PROCESSING FEE DUE TO ANTRIM COUNTY TREASURER AS THE ACCEPTANCE AGENT CHILD - UNDER 16 YEARS OLD - NOTE: For minor applications, the child and both parents must be present Passport Book - $100.00 Passport Card - $15.00 Passport Book & Card - $115.00 EACH APPLICATION HAS A $35 PROCESSING FEE DUE TO ANTRIM COUNTY TREASURER AS THE ACCEPTANCE AGENT TWO SEPARATE CHECKS (personal, certified, cashier's, traveler's) OR MONEY ORDER REQUIRED Please note: Starter checks NOT accepted 1. First check payable to: U.S. DEPARTMENT OF STATE 2. Second check payable to: ANTRIM COUNTY TREASURER ($35 processing fee) REQUIRED DOCUMENTS TO APPLY FOR A PASSPORT: Form - Filled out with Black Ink ONLY A Passport Photo - No glasses in photo. No camouflage. Birth Certificate with a raised seal NOT A COPY OR a previous issued Passport Valid Driver's License - The parent's driver's license will be used for a Child's Passport DO NOT SIGN APPLICATION UNTIL YOU SUBMIT IT TO THE ACCEPTANCE AGENT AT A PASSPORT ACCEPTANCE FACILITY - You MUST sign application in front of an acceptance agent NO ON SITE PHOTOS - NO PHOTO FACILITES LOCATED IN ANTRIM COUNTY PASSPORT RENEWAL You can renew by mail if you answer 'yes' to ALL 5 statements below about your passport: You have your passport in your possession to submit with your application It's undamaged other than normal wear and tear Was issued when you were age 16 or older Was issued within the last 15 years (expired 5 years or less) Was issued in your current name or you can document your name change If you answered 'NO' to any statement, you must apply in person using Form DS-11. Passport Renewal Applications are available at the County Treasurer's Office or online at www.travel.state.gov HOW LONG WILL IT TAKE TO GET MY PASSPORT? Routine Service: 6-8 weeks (after received by Passport agency) Expedited Service: 2-3 weeks (after received by Passport agency) - extra $60.00 fee applies to expedite MAILING TIMES ARE NOT INCLUDED IN PROCESSING TIMES. Consider the total time it will take to receive your passport when you are booking travel. Urgent applying at Detroit Agency : MUST HAVE INTERNATIONAL TRAVEL WITHIN 14 CALENDAR DAYS. TO MAKE AN APPOINTMENT CALL 1-877-487-2778 from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Mondays through Fridays, or on Saturdays and Sundays from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. This appointment line is closed on federal holidays. HOW MUCH IS A PASSPORT RENEWAL? Passport Book - $130.00 Passport Card - $30.00 Passport Book & Card - $160.00 Check payable to: U.S. DEPARTMENT OF STATE Please note: Starter checks NOT accepted. Check MUST be personal, certified, cashier's, traveler's or money order.
